SEAMLESS FULL HOME TRANSFORMATIONS WITH LASTING LUXURY

At Integral Renovations, we specialize in transforming homes to better suit the evolving needs of our clients. Whether you’re looking to update a kitchen, renovate a master bathroom, or add an extra bedroom for a growing family, our home remodeling services in Buford, GA, can help bring your vision to life. With years of experience, our team of skilled designers, contractors, and project managers ensures that your renovation project is executed flawlessly, from concept to completion.

Our goal is to deliver a stress-free experience for homeowners by handling the entire process, from the initial design phase to the finished product. We believe that every detail matters and never cut corners, ensuring that your home looks stunning and functions perfectly for years to come.

WHY CHOOSE INTEGRAL RENOVATIONS FOR YOUR HOME REMODEL?

When it comes to a home remodel, choosing the right company is crucial. At Integral Renovations, we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.

Whether you’re renovating a single room or undertaking a complete home makeover, we offer personalized solutions tailored to your specific needs. Here’s why clients trust us with their renovation project:

Customized Designs: No two homes are the same, and neither are our remodeling solutions. We work closely with you to create a design that reflects your personal style and maximizes the potential of your space.
Experienced Contractors: Our team of experienced contractors and craftsmen ensures that every job is completed to the highest standards. From installing new cabinets to reworking walls, we handle even the most complex projects with precision.
Transparent Cost Estimates: We provide clear, detailed estimates so you understand the cost of your remodel from the start. We work within your budget and strive to deliver the best value for your money.
Attention to Detail: We don’t cut corners—every aspect of your remodel is carefully considered, from the materials used to the finishing touches.
THE COMPLETE HOME REMODELING PROCESS

At Integral Renovations, we pride ourselves on offering a seamless renovation process that keeps you informed and engaged at every step. Here’s what you can expect during your home remodel:

01
Initial Consultation

We begin with a thorough consultation to discuss your goals, design preferences, and budget. This is where you can share your vision and any concerns you may have.

02
Design and Planning

Once we understand your needs, our design team will create a customized plan for your remodel. We’ll work with you to select materials, finishes, and layouts that align with your vision for the finished product.

03
Construction and Installation

Our skilled contractors take care of every detail, from demolition to installation. Whether we’re adding new cabinets, upgrading
bathrooms, or creating an extra bedroom, we handle all aspects of the job with precision.

04
Final Walkthrough

Once your remodel is complete, we’ll walk you through the finished product to ensure it meets your expectations. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we’ll address any concerns to ensure you’re completely happy with your newly renovated home.

OUTDOOR LIVING SPACES THAT EXPAND YOUR HOME

Transform your outdoor living space into a beautiful and functional area where you can relax, entertain, and enjoy the natural surroundings. At Integral Renovations, we specialize in creating outdoor living spaces that are designed to meet your specific needs and lifestyle. Whether you’re dreaming of a cozy, private outdoor space for family gatherings or a larger entertainment area for hosting guests, our team is here to bring your vision to life.

With years of experience, we have become a trusted deck and patio company dedicated to delivering high-quality craftsmanship, durable materials, and stunning designs. From custom decks to patios and patio covers, our work enhances the functionality and beauty of your outdoor space while adding value to your home.

WHY CHOOSE INTEGRAL RENOVATIONS FOR YOUR OUTDOOR LIVING SPACE PROJECT ?

As a leading deck and patio company, we understand that creating a beautiful outdoor space requires attention to detail, excellent project management, and the use of the best materials available. At Integral Renovations, our project managers work closely with each client to ensure that every aspect of the design and build process meets their needs. We take pride in providing customized solutions that complement your home’s architecture, reflect your personal style, and create lasting value.

Custom Designs:We tailor every project to fit the unique preferences and lifestyle of our clients.

Professional Project Management: Our experienced project managers oversee every phase of the project, ensuring that timelines and budgets are respected.
Comprehensive Services: We handle everything from initial design to construction and ongoing maintenance.
OUR OUTDOOR LIVING SPACES SERVICES INCLUDE
Custom Deck Design and Installation

Your deck should be more than just an extension of your home—it should be a functional and aesthetically pleasing outdoor living space where you can enjoy the beauty of your surroundings. As expert deck builders, we create custom decks that are designed to meet your specific needs. Whether you envision a multi-level deck for large gatherings or a small, private deck for personal relaxation, we have the experience and skills to bring your vision to life.

Our deck builder services include everything from concept and design to construction. We work with a variety of materials, including natural wood and composite decking, to create decks that are both durable and visually appealing.

Patio Design and Construction

A well-designed patio can significantly enhance your outdoor space, creating a versatile area for dining, relaxing, or entertaining. Integral Renovations offers custom patio design and construction services that are tailored to fit your home’s architectural style and your personal preferences. We specialize in using high-quality materials such as stone, pavers, and concrete to craft patios that are both functional and visually stunning.

In addition to traditional patios, we also offer the installation of patio covers to protect your outdoor living spaces from the elements. Our patio covers not only provide shade and protection but also add to the overall aesthetic of your outdoor space.

Deck Repair and Maintenance

Over time, decks can show signs of wear and tear, especially if exposed to the elements. If your existing deck is starting to fade, warp, or suffer from other issues, our deck repair and maintenance services can help restore it to its original beauty and functionality.

We provide a range of repair services, from replacing damaged boards to resealing and staining, ensuring that your deck remains a safe and enjoyable space for years to come.

Outdoor Kitchens and Entertainment Spaces

To fully maximize the potential of your outdoor living space, consider adding an outdoor kitchen or entertainment area. We specialize in designing and constructing outdoor kitchens that are perfect for entertaining family and friends.

From built-in grills and countertops to seating areas and outdoor fireplaces, we can transform your outdoor space into a fully equipped entertainment hub.

Patio Covers for Comfort and Style

Installing patio covers is one of the best ways to protect your outdoor areas from harsh weather while enhancing the aesthetic appeal of your home. At Integral Renovations, we offer a wide selection of patio covers that are designed to match the style of your home and provide shade and comfort.

Whether you prefer sleek modern designs
or more traditional styles, we have the expertise to install patio covers that will seamlessly integrate with your patio and make your outdoor living space more functional and inviting.

MATERIALS WE USE FOR OUTDOOR LIVING SPACES

At Integral Renovations, we are committed to using only the highest quality materials for our projects. This ensures that your outdoor space not only looks beautiful but also lasts for years to come. We offer a variety of materials for decks and patios, including:

Natural wood

Known for its timeless beauty and natural warmth, natural wood is a popular choice for homeowners looking for a classic look. We use durable woods such as cedar and redwood, which are resistant to rot and insect damage.

Composite decking

For homeowners looking for a low-maintenance option, composite decking offers the look of wood without the upkeep. This material is resistant to fading, scratching, and staining, making it an excellent choice for busy households.

Stone and pavers

For patios, we use a range of stone and pavers to create custom designs that complement your home’s exterior and landscaping.

A professionally designed and built deck or patio can transform your outdoor living space, providing an area for relaxation, entertainment, and family gatherings. Beyond enhancing your lifestyle, a well-constructed deck or patio can also increase the value of your home.
